intellectual_tradition: 象山之学（心学奠基人），与兄陆九韶、陆九龄并称'三陆子'；后与王阳明并称'陆王心学'
representative_works: 《象山先生全集》（语录、书信为主）
《与朱元晦书》（鹅湖之辩前后通信）
《大学春秋讲义》《荆门军政记录》
《语录》（《象山语录》，门人傅子云等记）
historical_significance: 陆九渊（1139—1193），字子静，号存斋，世称象山先生，抚州金溪人，南宋心学奠基者。乾道八年进士，历任靖安、崇安县主簿，国子正，敕令所删定官，晚年知荆门军，政绩卓著。'鹅湖之会'（1175）与朱熹论学而不合，开宋明理学'尊德性'与'道问学'两大路径之争的序幕。其学以'心即理'为纲：'宇宙便是吾心，吾心即是宇宙'；'六经皆我注脚'。持'先立乎其大者'的简易工夫，反对朱熹支离的格物穷理。荆门任上修城练兵、罢关市税、讲论经义，为政与讲学合一。明王阳明承其脉而成'陆王心学'，其'人皆可以为尧舜'的平民讲学传统下启泰州学派。
core_thoughts: 心即理（本心即天理，不假外求）
宇宙便是吾心，吾心即是宇宙
六经皆我注脚（经典服务于本心的开展）
先立乎其大者（立志为先的简易工夫）
本心之发明（'汝昨日安在？'点醒詹阜民）
简易工夫（减法修养，非加法穷索）
鹅湖之辩（尊德性与道问学的路线之争）
人情物理（'人情物理上做工夫'的平实之学）
荆门之政（讲学即行政，政学合一）
量力读书·优游涵泳（反对躐等与硬塞）
famous_quote: 宇宙便是吾心，吾心即是宇宙（《象山语录》）；学苟知本，六经皆我注脚；先立乎其大者，而其小者不能夺也
influence: 陆九渊是宋明心学的源头：'心即理'三字把道德本体的位置从外在天理移入人心，直接下启王阳明'心外无理，心外无物'。鹅湖之辩确立了中国思想史上'尊德性'（象山）与'道问学'（朱子）的经典对峙——朱熹晚年亦叹'惜其寿不永'并取其简易之长。他全凭语录书信、终身无体系大著，靠讲学与点拨传学：'收拾精神，自作主宰，万物皆备于我'。其讲学不立学规而立气象，象山精舍听者云集，'郡县礼乐之士，时相谒访'。明代陈献章、湛若水、王阳明一脉皆自此出；现代新儒家（牟宗三）更推其为儒学正脉的'大宗'。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: '宇宙便是吾心，吾心即是宇宙。'——把心与宇宙的同构直接立为命题：不是心去'符合'外理，而是理就在心的伸展中显现，内外本无隔。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: 'The universe is my mind; my mind is the universe.' Mind and cosmos are affirmed as isomorphic—principle does not lie outside to be conformed to, but manifests in the mind's own unfolding.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: '学苟知本，六经皆我注脚。'——经典地位倒转：不是我去注解六经，而是六经为我本心的注脚；读书的标准是能否发明本心，而非记诵多少。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: 'If learning grasps the root, the Six Classics are all footnotes to me.' The canonical hierarchy inverts: the classics annotate the mind, not vice versa—reading is judged by whether it illumines the original mind.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 鹅湖之会（1175）与朱熹辩'教人之法'：朱以'泛观博览而后归之约'，陆以'先发明人之本心而后使之博览'，陆赋诗讥朱'支离'，朱讥陆'空疏'——两种学习路线的正面交锋，双方各自坚持到底又终身互相敬重。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: At the Goose Lake Meeting (1175) Zhu Xi advocated breadth-then-synthesis while Lu insisted on illumining the original mind first; Lu mocked Zhu's 'fragmentation,' Zhu Lu's 'emptiness'—each holding his line for life yet honoring the other.
mode_evidence.source: 《陆九渊年谱》；《朱子语类》卷一百二十四

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: '先立乎其大者，而其小者不能夺也。'（引孟子）——工夫次序上把'立志立大体'放在一切具体学习之前：大体一立，小者（闻见、才艺、利害）自然归位、不能摇动。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: 'First establish what is great, and the small cannot displace it' (citing Mencius). Sequence matters: secure the great orientation before any particular learning—the small then falls into place.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 詹阜民侍坐，先生' sudden 起立'问其近来所得，答未毕，先生曰：'汝昨者安在？'——不靠说理而靠临场一问逼出本心的当下呈现：点拨式教学，直指而非灌输。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: To the disciple Zhan Fumin Lu suddenly asked, 'Where was your original mind just now?'—awakening presence by a pointed live question rather than by exposition: direct pointing instead of instruction.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: '易简工夫终久大，支离事业竟浮沉。'（鹅湖诗）——方法论上主张减法：去掉层层外在积累的'支离'，以'易简'直契本心；并预言简易者长久、支离者浮沉。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: 'The easy and simple endures and grows great; the fragmented bobs and sinks' (Goose Lake poem). A subtractive methodology: cut accumulative fragmentation and hit the root directly.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: '收拾精神，自作主宰，万物皆备于我，有何欠阙。'——把散逸于外物的注意力收回，由自己做自己生命的主权者：修学的核心操作是注意力主权与自我主宰。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: 'Gather in the spirit, be master of yourself: all things are complete in me—what is lacking?' The core operation is reclaiming attention-sovereignty and self-mastery from dispersion.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 知荆门军：修城郭、练民兵、革税务积弊、朔望讲《洪范》敛福锡民之义——把讲学直接变成治理：一郡之内'民无争讼，夜户不闭'，证明心学非空谈而有实政。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: As prefect of Jingmen he walled the city, trained militia, reformed taxes, and lectured on the Great Plan every new and full moon—turning teaching directly into governance; lawsuits fell away and doors went unbarred at night.
mode_evidence.source: 《宋史·陆九渊传》；《象山先生行状》

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: '人情物理上做工夫'——反对把学问悬在玄远处：本心之发用即在人情物理的平实处，读书讲论要落到具体人情与事物之理上验证。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: 'Do the work upon human feeling and the principle of things'—against suspension in the remote: the mind's function shows in ordinary feeling and affairs, where learning must be tested.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: '读书固不可不读，但须量力，且优游涵泳，久之自得。'——反对躐等硬塞：读书如饮食，须量力、涵泳、待其自化，以学习者自身的生长节律为节奏。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: 'Books must be read, but within one's capacity—steep and simmer gently, and in time it comes of itself.' Against cramming: reading like eating, paced to the learner's own rhythm of growth.

cross_references.relation_note: 朱熹(1130-1200)为陆九渊(1139-1193)同时代人，此处为思想谱系对照
cross_references.description_zh: 陆九渊与朱熹同源而反：同承二程'天理'之教，朱熹把理放在事物之上而'即物穷理'，陆九渊把理收进本心而'心即理'。鹅湖之辩是这两条路线的公开交锋——尊德性（先立大本）对道问学（泛观博览）。二人终身相辩又终身相敬，朱晚年取陆之简易，陆后学则渐融于朱学，直到王阳明重新点燃象山之脉。
cross_references.description_en: Lu and Zhu share the Cheng lineage yet invert each other: Zhu locates principle in things and studies them outward, Lu gathers principle into the mind—'mind is principle.' The Goose Lake debate staged reverence-for-virtue against inquiry-and-study; they contested all their lives yet honored each other, until Wang Yangming rekindled the Xiangshan line.

cross_references.description_zh: 程颢'天理二字自家体贴出来'与'仁者浑然与物同体'为心学埋下伏笔：陆九渊把明道'体贴'的路径推到底——本体既在自家体贴处，则不必外索，'心即理'。朱熹尊明道而折向伊川，陆九渊则自认全接明道血脉；'尊德性/道问学'两脉在二程兄弟处已见分野。
cross_references.description_en: Cheng Hao's 'self-realized Tianli' and 'one body with all things' prefigure the School of Mind: Lu radicalizes the Mingdao path—since the root is self-attained, seek nothing outside, hence 'mind is principle.' Zhu followed Yichuan; Lu claimed Cheng Hao entire.

cross_references.description_zh: 董仲舒把真理的担保放在'天'——'道之大原出于天'，人须敬畏地顺应天道秩序；陆九渊把担保移入人心——'万物皆备于我'。同样是确立道德的客观性，一个向外立天以约束君权，一个向内立心以解放个体：中国思想中'外在超越'与'内在超越'的两种方案。
cross_references.description_en: Dong Zhongshu anchors truth in Heaven, restraining the ruler by an outer order; Lu anchors it in the mind—'all things are complete in me.' Outer transcendence versus inner transcendence: two Chinese solutions to securing morality.

modern_value_zh: 心即理——内在主权思维：把判断的最终根据收回自己心中，适用于信息过载时代'谁替我做决定'的问题
六经皆我注脚——以我为主体的知识消费观：读任何框架/经典都为澄清自己的问题服务，而非被术语绑架
先立乎其大者——次序优先思维：先定大体与方向，再处理细节，防止'忙碌于小事而失去大局'
易简对支离——减法方法论：当系统复杂到失灵时，砍掉层层中介、直击根问题，往往比继续加法更有效
收拾精神自作主宰——注意力主权：在注意力经济中把注意力的支配权从平台收回到自己，是一切修养的起点
modern_value_en: Mind as principle: reclaim the final ground of judgment to your own mind—an answer to decision outsourcing in the information age
Classics as my footnotes: reader-sovereignty—every framework serves your question, not vice versa
Establish the great first: sequence over detail—set direction before optimizing fragments
Simplicity against fragmentation: when systems fail from complexity, subtract intermediaries and hit the root
Gather the spirit, self-mastery: attention sovereignty over platforms as the starting point of any cultivation
place_of_origin: 抚州金溪（今江西金溪县陆坊村）
unique_thing: 陆九渊的核心成就是一次'方向的倒转'与'教学法的发明'：他把理学刚立起的'外在天理'整个搬回人心——'心即理'、'宇宙便是吾心'，从此'尊德性'与'道问学'成为此后七百年儒学的两条主干道；他又几乎不写著作（全集以语录书信为主），全靠临场点拨传学——一句'汝昨者安在'、一首鹅湖诗，比论文更有奠基力。他证明：思想史上的路线之争未必是输赢之争——朱陆终身不合却互相成全，'支离'与'简易'作为两种互补的学习论被后世同时继承。最大的遗产是那条简易原则：当所有人都往学问里加东西时，先问一句——本心立了没有？
